purpose: Sketch of a third input on the words of version 3 of the series of translators (decision 8 of .steering/20261028-harada-reply-and-translators): the same 20 words per translation, each drawn twice under the rule of work 1, with (V, A) as in version 3 and with the dominance D of the lexicon added to gamma, in the form of the hypothetical third input of Supplement S6 of the paper on the rule (gamma + 0.3 D, f and s unchanged). Images and a measure of how much D changes a tile; whether D makes the translations easier to tell apart is read by eye only.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before the script was run. Seen before: the record and figure of version 3 (0d9744b): the 60 words with their V and A, the readings, the audit (function words and naming variants on top; seven words of the first translation have V = A = 0). Over the whole lexicon (not these texts) the main agent computed the correlations V-D 0.47, A-D 0.33, V-A -0.08, and saw that ten common function words have D = 0 or nearly. Not seen before: D of any of the 60 words, any tile with D. The researcher chose to try D on 2026-10-28 (AskUserQuestion); the trial on work 2 waits until the researcher has given the answers of the blind judgement. The draft of the previous session was reviewed by the main agent on 2026-10-28 before any run; added then, still before any run: the median between words of the VAD tiles, the spread of gamma and gamma' over the 20 words and their rank correlation (to read whether D separates the words more, not only how much it moves each). After the review by code-reviewer (opus), still before any run: the tile without eps (the draft used T_{gamma', eps}, which is not the H of version 3; the check against relief.tile caught it), the base conditions checked against the SHA-256 named by version 3, the lexicon read once, s and dH / s per word, the number of pairs of words with the same VA tile, the range of gamma', D outside [-1, 1] stops the run, the labels of pairs.png.
base_conditions: works/conditions/sketch_translations_words.json (version 3) and, through it, works/conditions/sketch_translations.json (lexicon, generator, relief)
words_from: results/sketch_translations_words/sketch_translations_words.json (the 20 words per translation in z order, as recorded; nothing is selected again)
dominance: read from the lexicon file of the base conditions: the fourth column, the term normalised and skipped exactly as atact.lexicon.load_lexicon does (tokenize, skip a term that the tokenizer cannot produce as written); the V and A read alongside must equal lex.entries of the generator for every word, else the run stops

third_input.rule: (f, s, gamma) = atact.mapping.params(V, A) and gamma' = gamma + gamma_weight D (D in [-1, 1], a value outside stops the run); the tile is s T_{gamma'}(F) with the field and seed of version 3 and without eps, as relief.tile computes H (the H that version 3 drew)
third_input.source: Supplement S6 of the paper on the rule: the smallest change that moves gamma alone, not a proposal for the rule

measure: per word: dH = the root mean square over the grid of (z_VAD - z_VA) in mm under the common scale; per translation: the median of dH; as references the median over pairs of its 20 words of the root mean square of (z_VA,i - z_VA,j), and the same for the VAD tiles; the standard deviation (ddof 0) of gamma and of gamma' over the 20 words and the Spearman correlation of gamma and gamma' (ties at mean ranks, as works/sketch_translations.spearman); per translation the mean and standard deviation (ddof 0) of D over its 20 words and the number of words whose D is 0. The words differ in f, so the between-words reference is dominated by the pattern of the field, not by the amplitude or sharpness; a dH below it does not mean that D is invisible. dH is proportional to s (the VA and VAD tiles share s), so dH / s is reported beside it. Pairs of words with the same VA tile (V = A = 0 for several words of the first translation) have a VA difference of 0 and can separate under VAD; their number is reported, and a larger VAD median partly reflects them.
tiles: the layout, field, font and labels of version 3 (works/conditions/sketch_translations_words.json, tiles); the label adds D to two decimals; in pairs.png the number under each tile is its position (1 to 40), not the rank of the word: the word of rank k is at positions 2k-1 (labelled 'word VA') and 2k ('word VAD')
outputs: results/sketch_translations_words_d/sketch_translations_words_d.json and results/sketch_translations_words_d/{words_vad.png, pairs.png} (words_vad.png: the three blocks of VAD tiles in the layout of version 3; pairs.png: for each translation, the VA tile and the VAD tile of each word side by side, in z order)
reported: per word V, A, D, gamma, gamma', dH; per translation the measures above
not_claimed: D is not independent of V in this lexicon (0.47 over all terms), so part of what it adds repeats V. Function words have D near 0, so D does not change their tiles. The weight 0.3 is the hypothetical value of S6, not tuned. Whether a third input survives depends on the scale: under the min-max export the rank is 2 (S6); these images use the common scale. Nothing here says that D shows a difference between the translators; the images are read by eye by the makers only. gamma' ranges over about 0.6 to 2.9, wider than the image of the rule (0.9 to 2.6), so some VAD tiles lie outside the shapes the rule can make.
